description:
A corporate analyst needs to configure JStock to use their company's HTTP proxy server. Open JStock's Options/Preferences dialog (look under the Edit menu or a toolbar/menu button labeled 'Options'), navigate to the Proxy settings section, and configure the following proxy details:

- Proxy Server: proxy.acmecorp.net
- Proxy Port: 3128

After entering the values, confirm the settings by clicking OK or Apply to save. The proxy configuration should persist in JStock's configuration files.
